ms.report:
Hello.
We have published our work in progress on Binocular.
Here is the project repository with current proof of concept implementation:
https://github.com/lantr-io/binocular
Here is a Litepaper draft: https://github.com/lantr-io/binocular/blob/e1073f1d2e87b26db7f4418e745c3d3a47c63963/Litepaper.md
And here is a first Whitepaper draft: https://github.com/lantr-io/binocular/blob/e1073f1d2e87b26db7f4418e745c3d3a47c63963/Whitepaper.md
These are their respective PDF versions:
https://github.com/lantr-io/binocular/blob/e1073f1d2e87b26db7f4418e745c3d3a47c63963/Litepaper.pdf
https://github.com/lantr-io/binocular/blob/e1073f1d2e87b26db7f4418e745c3d3a47c63963/Whitepaper.pdf
We are still researching some aspects of the protocol, trying to make it more efficient and cheap, so we'll refine the whitepaper in the next milestone, as promised.
We also include the implementation of Bitcoin block heaader validation logic as Cardano smart contract.

ms.report:
A. Output: Refined Litepaper
Acceptance criteria: The refined litepaper Markdown and PDF documents are provided.
Evidence: High-level protocol overview covering architecture, key concepts, security analysis, and economic attack costs.
・Litepaper.md | PDF

B. Output: Refined Whitepaper
Acceptance criteria: The refined whitepaper Markdown and PDF documents are provided.
Evidence: Complete technical specification including protocol design, data structures, algorithms with Bitcoin Core references, communication diagrams, formal state machine, and security proofs.
・Whitepaper.md | PDF

C. Output: Revised Binocular smart contract state machine
Acceptance criteria: The revised Binocular smart contract is available on the GitHub of the project.
Evidence: Plutus validator implementing Bitcoin consensus validation (PoW, difficulty adjustment, timestamps), fork management, canonical chain selection, and block promotion logic.
・BitcoinValidator.scala - Main validator
・ValidatorTest.scala - Test suite

D. Output: Off-chain client implementation
Acceptance criteria: A proof of concept implementation of the Binocular Oracle that can be run on a testnet with functionality to: create an Oracle UTxO, update the Oracle with new Bitcoin blocks, use the Oracle to construct proofs of transaction inclusion on Bitcoin.
Evidence: Command-line application for interacting with the Binocular Oracle on Cardano testnet/mainnet.
・CliApp.scala - Main CLI application with all commands
・InitOracleCommand.scala - Creates initial Oracle UTxO
・UpdateOracleCommand.scala - Submits new Bitcoin blocks
・ProveTransactionCommand.scala - Generates transaction inclusion proofs

E. Output: Testnet demonstration - Oracle UTxO creation
Acceptance criteria: Successful demonstration of creating an Oracle UTxO on testnet.
Evidence: Transaction creating the initial Binocular Oracle UTxO with ChainState datum on Preview testnet.
・Oracle Script Deployment
・Tx: https://preprod.cexplorer.io/tx/693c1f024ab5439d9438db446366
